Returning Seller Fulfilled Items

The return timelines for seller-fulfilled items sold on Amazon.in are equivalent to the return timelines mentioned above for items fulfilled by Amazon.

If you’ve received a seller-fulfilled product in a condition that is damaged, defective or different from its description on the product detail page on Amazon.in, returns are subject to the seller's approval of the return.

If you do not receive a response from the seller for your return request within two business days, you can submit an A-to-Z Guarantee claim. Learn more about returning seller fulfilled items.

Note: For seller fulfilled items from Books, Movies & TV Shows categories, the sellers need to be informed of the damage/ defect within 14 days of delivery.

For seller-fulfilled items from Fine Art category, the sellers need to be informed of the damage / defect within 10 days of delivery. These items are not eligible for self-return. The seller will arrange the return pick up for these items.

For seller-fulfilled items from Sports collectibles and Entertainment collectibles categories, the sellers need to be informed of the damage / defect within 10 days of delivery.
Returning Global Store Items

The General Return Policy is applicable for all Amazon Global Store Products (“Product”). If the Product is eligible for a refund on return, you can choose to return the Product either through courier Pickup or Self-Return**

Note: - Once the package is received at Amazon Export Sales LLC fulfillment center in the US, it takes 2 (two) business days for the refund to be processed and 2- 4 business days for the refund amount to reflect in your account. - If your return is due to an Amazon error you'll receive a full refund, else the shipping charges (onward & return) along with import fees will be deducted from your refund amount.

**For products worth more than INR 25000, we only offer Self-Return option.

    • Ashish Bisht
      4 out of 5 stars
      Lava Play Ultra 5G Full Review
      Reviewed in India on 3 September 2025
      Colour: Arctic SlateSize: 8GB RAM
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      The phone is quite good. I recently purchased it, and with its 5000 mAh battery, it lasted around 1.5 days for me. That’s with about 3 hours of YouTube, 2 hours of WhatsApp calling, and at least 1.5 hours of regular calls, and I still had around 35% battery left.

      I think that’s a solid performance, especially with the specs it offers, like UFS 3.1 storage and LPDDR4X RAM. I bought it for ₹14,648, which is under ₹15K, and honestly, I feel it’s a very good deal. The display quality is also nice. It comes with Panda protection instead of Gorilla Glass, but at the end of the day, it’s more about how carefully we handle the phone.

      The sound quality is good too, thanks to the dual speakers. The haptic feedback isn’t the most refined, but for this budget range, it’s more than acceptable. The home repair service is another plus point. I’d definitely call this purchase a good deal overall.

      As for the camera, I’d say it’s decent but not outstanding. Outdoor shots tend to look a bit too saturated, especially with greens, but the HDR works well, and the video quality is impressive for the price. Surprisingly, I found the front camera to be better than what I’ve seen on many phones in this range, especially since it doesn’t rely too heavily on beauty filters.

      At last, the best thing in this range is no bloatware on the phone and no paid and extra Ads. in a budget range with near stock Android.

      I’ll attach a few samples for reference.

      4 out of 5 stars
      CMF2 pro vs Lava play ultra
      Reviewed in India on 19 January 2026
      Colour: Arctic FrostSize: 8GB RAM
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.
      Full content visible, double tap to read brief content.

      Reviewing after using a month here are the pros,, cons and my expectations.Note this review is implies to Lava not to Amazon.(Apart from not sending me the hard receipt which should be with Amazon box So, down thumb to you Amazon)

      Camera : As of now the camera department doing excellent work interms of my expectations clicking good pictures and honestly no complaint.

      However these days, after updating software phone's camera downgraded in many devices so solely depends on future updates.(Saw many brand )

      Pictures zooming during shoot of photo is only 1x and 2x which I feel not enough but still pictures are vibrant and upto the mark 👍

      So my rating is for camera is 9/10

      Battery: Now before buying this device I had option to chose between CMF 2 pro and this Lava play ultra

      and I took 2 weeks to decide which should be suit for me and one thing which is clear different between was less battery consumption of lava because no 2nd party UI. However as of now it's not what I was expecting especially in battery back quite disappointed because back is not up to the mark despite low background process but maybe because 120hz display don't know the exact reason, Avarage battery backup.I will not saying bad but atleast it didn't match my expectations atleast yet.

      So my rating is 8/10.(Hopefully they fix in next update if possible)

      Software: Here I chose lava over CMF 2 pro the reason was the software which based on stock android and it's as of now snappy and smooth so no complaint about here.However these days many smartphone after update become slow and laggy so solely depends and update.

      My rating here is 8/10

      Display: Here, during outdoor usage display was bright enough and thankfully they use Amoled display so here no complaint about the display.

      My ratings is 9/10

      Performance: As of now smooth switching between apps and games no problem during day to day task and here am fully satisfied as of now.No complaint here .

      So my rating is 9/10

      Speaker: Another major reason I chose lava over cmf2 pro because speaker department and honestly saying it's one of the best phone interms of quality of speaker as compared to CMF 2 pro. Excellent for listening music and watching any content with this dual speaker and I don't think any smartphone brand come to this close interms of speaker quality (atleast in this price range) one of the best.

      My ratings is whooping 10/10

      Final opinion: I was looking for a device which I can use next 3-4 years without worrying about future updates like these days brands tampered with software update so old phones can't be used after update, like downgrading camera, battery backup,and performance all this things with a healthy budget and I found this phone which all the specs I was looking for however I had a chance for CMF 2 pro but in CMF there was bad speaker quality, 6 years security patches in 128gb storage which enough to slow your phone,no 3.5 mm jack.But in lava I have all the specs which mentioned (However I want to see lava do better interms of longer update cycle hopefully)

      So my overall rating for this phone is 9/10

      One of the best phones in market I bought this for 13k in the last days of December 2025 for my mom I didn't expected this phone to be packed up with so much hardware and smooth UI with stock Android, so I wanted to buy another one for me as I needed a phone but it's priced at 16k just when we entered 2026. All is good in this phone design is premium only the camera optimization can be better but it's usable and can't complain at this price I won't complain much as perfect phone doesn't exists. Battery charges up very fast with the charger provided in box and onscreen fingerprint is fast awith great AMOLED display, colours are great I love the display... Just one suggestion to the always on display if gets an update will be better as it stops after sometime of screenlock but that's only to save battery, for my mom the phone lasts about 3 days with only calling and few internet usage as her usage is minimalistic. Overall this Indian brand phone should be more praised for what we get at this price worldwide as most of us Indians even don't know about it much and buy Chinese brands which are enough where near it at this price, also the after sales service amwith in home service is a edge over other brands.

      3 out of 5 stars
      Good option to consider in this budget midrange.
      Reviewed in India on 4 October 2025
      Colour: Arctic FrostSize: 6GB RAM
      Verified Purchase
      Brief content visible, double tap to read full content.

      I am sharing this review after one month of usages. This is my honest review about this phone.

      After got the delivery of phone. I complete the initial setup and turn on the vibrations and haptics. But soon after 2-3 hrs the vibrations and haptics automatically stop working and after restarting the phone they again started and this goes on. So I registered the complaint. The Lava after delivery service is very good. I did not face any issues while registering the complaint. It was a smooth process through WhatsApp and just one call to the customer care. After complaint registration, the service person visit my home and took my phone. As it is just 2 days after buying the phone he took the entire box along with accessories. I got the new fully packed phone after 5 days. So overall the after sales service experience is good. The new phone is now correctly and does not have any vibrations or haptics issue.

      Now about my one month experience, the phone is good. It has a decent camera which clicks the good pictures in good lighting. The phone has very good display. The quality of the picture is very good. The speakers are loud and clear which makes multimedia experience really good. The performance is decent. Day to day life tasks are working smoothly without any lag. Connectivity is good. No issues in call observe till now. Phone is slim and durable so looks good in hand. Now the feedback about software. The software is stock android with some lava customisations which gives good experience but there are some bugs present. If different wallpaper applies to home screen and lock screen then sometimes it automatically applies same wallpaper to both but in the wallpaper settings you get to know the wallpaper is different. The major issue I noticed is with the Alarm. If I setup the Alarm for early morning then it will never ring and Alarm app is giving warning (screenshot attached) which is very disappointed. Every morning I noticed same issue is there. So this type of software bugs are present which might be fix through the software updates but as first time buyer of Lava and the trust I put on the Indian brand, the experience is not upto the mark.

      So hope anyone reading this long review message find helpful and considering this you can make your purchase decision.
